result.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
result.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://middle-chunjie.github.io/AnyS1/
result.summary: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.

AI.brief_summary: AnyS1 把人类编写的流程技能自动转化为「决策点」，在容器中收集执行轨迹状态构建 Any-DP 数据集，训练一个校准过的 4B pointer 小模型，在枚举候选中一步选出常规动作，置信度低于阈值时回退到大模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「轻量一步决策 + 校准置信度触发回退」可供核查 LVR 中的 STOP 与动态计算分配问题，基于执行轨迹状态训练决策头也可能为 latent 状态的监督与贡献分配提供线索；但对象是纯文本 agent 动作选择，无视觉或内部推理状态，可迁移性待验证。
